clean_source_blocks.text: The former One Direction singer has taken to Instagram to update fans as he cuts his world tour dates
The former One Direction singer issued a statement on his Instagram page telling fans he had to take "another look" at his schedule.
Former One Direction star Zayn Malik has announced he will be reducing the number of shows on his upcoming tour, weeks after posting on social media from a hospital bed.

As previously noted, Zayn has been battling an unknown illness for at least several weeks. In April, he shared a photo from a hospital bed to his Instagram Stories the same day that he released his album Konnakol.
